logs.name: Server logs
logs.description: Route Discord events to your log channels, category by category.
logs.savedButInactive: Saved, but no category has a channel — nothing will be logged.
logs.categoriesDescription: {{categories}} categories, {{events}} events. Boxes are checked by default: only what you uncheck is stored, so events added later start on.
logs.duplicateChannelHint: One act can belong to two categories (a ban is both a server event and a moderation event). If both point to the same channel, only one message is sent.
logs.requiredPermissions: Moddy needs {{permissions}} in every log channel.
logs.categoryChannelsHint: Routing happens per category, never per event. Threads work as long as they stay active — an archived thread is treated as missing.
logs.eventsHint: Only unchecked events are stored. Anything Moddy adds to this category later starts logged.
logs.soonHint: Declared but not emitted by anything yet. Leave it checked: it turns on by itself the day the feature ships.
logs.partialHint: Only fires for restrict and revoke_access sanctions today; the other case updates stay silent.
logs.filtersDescription: What never gets logged, whatever the category.
logs.ignoredChannelsHint: Every channel type is accepted here — it is an exclusion list, not a destination.
logs.ignoredRolesHint: Members carrying one of these roles produce no log.
logs.ignoreBotsHint: Skip everything done by a bot account.
logs.outputDescription: How the messages themselves are sent.
logs.attachTranscriptsHint: Attach the .txt files (transcripts, overflowing content). Turn it off to strip them before sending.
logs.mergeDuplicatesHint: Group the logs of a single action into one message (adds a ~3 s delay, up to ~5 s for a kick).
logs.unlinkAllHint: Unlinking pauses the module and keeps your unchecked events. Resetting deletes everything.
logs.confirmResetDescription: Channels, unchecked events and ignore lists are all deleted. To simply pause logging, unlink the channels instead — that keeps your exclusions.
logs.orphanWebhookDescription: The “Moddy Logs” webhook stays in {{channels}}. It is never reused, but you can delete it in Channel settings → Integrations.

diagnostics.deleted: {{channel}} no longer exists. Pick another channel, its logs go nowhere.

diagnostics.manageWebhooks: Moddy doesn't have Manage webhooks in {{channel}}. Logs are still sent, just more slowly during activity spikes (raid, message purge) — it loses batched sending and its dedicated send quota.

create.descriptionGlobal: Open a global case (Moddy network). A global ban blacklists the subject.

mass.confirmCloseDescription: {{count}} case(s) will be closed and locked. This can be reversed by reopening them.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.contextDescription: The messages leading up to the one flagged by AutoMod.

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Moddy sanctions breaches of its usage rules. This page lists what your account or your servers were flagged for, what it actually changes, and how to contest it. The rules are set out in
violations.premiumBlocked: You cannot subscribe while a sanction is on your account. An existing paid subscription stays manageable and cancellable.
violations.premiumGuildBlocked: This server is sanctioned and cannot be attached to a subscription.
violations.premiumSuspendedDescription: Your subscription still exists and is still paid, but the sanction makes it inoperative: Max features no longer apply. It will be cancelled, without refund, if the sanction is not lifted in time.

none.title: No active sanction
none.description: Nothing is held against you: you have access to all of Moddy.

warn.title: You have received a warning
warn.description: A breach of our rules was found and recorded. Nothing is blocked for now — your access to Moddy is exactly what it was. Another breach, however, leads to a limitation.

limited.title: Your access is limited
limited.description: Moddy keeps running on your servers and you can still adjust everything already set up. Two things are closed to you: subscribing to Moddy Max, and putting into service a module you had never configured before.

suspended.title: Your access is suspended
suspended.description: You no longer have access to the dashboard or to Moddy. This page is what remains, to understand why and to contest it.

list.emptyDescription: Nothing has been held against your account or your servers.

detail.notFoundDescription: This violation does not exist, or it does not concern you.
detail.appealDescription: Contests are handled on the Moddy support server, where a team member picks the case back up. Contesting does not pause the sanction: it stays in force while it is reviewed.

enforcement.pendingDescription: Unless a contest succeeds before {{date}}, the measures below will be applied.
enforcement.haltedDescription: The team paused the countdown while your contest is reviewed. The sanction itself stays in force.
enforcement.premiumWarning: Your paid subscription will be cancelled at the deadline, without refund.

banner.userLimitedTitle: Your access to Moddy is limited
banner.userLimitedDescription: You can still adjust the modules already set up. Subscribing to Moddy Max and putting a new module into service are closed to you.
banner.guildLimitedDescription: Moddy keeps running on {{guild}}, but AI moderation is off there and no new module can be put into service.
banner.guildSuspendedDescription: Moddy has left {{guild}}. Its settings are no longer reachable.
banner.newModuleBlockedTitle: This module cannot be put into service
banner.newModuleBlockedDescription: A sanction forbids enabling a module that has never been configured. The ones already set up stay fully editable.
banner.automodBlockedDescription: A sanction on this server turned AI moderation off: its settings are frozen until the sanction is lifted.

errors.premium_blocked_user: Subscribing is closed while your account is sanctioned
errors.premium_blocked_guild: This server cannot be attached to a subscription
errors.new_module_blocked: You cannot put a new module into service
errors.automod_ai_blocked: AI moderation is off on this server

errorSubject.discord_user: A sanction applies to your account.
errorSubject.discord_guild: A sanction applies to this server.

suspended.title: Your access to Moddy is suspended
suspended.description: A breach of our rules ended your access. This page stays available so you can see what you were flagged for and contest it. The rules are set out in
suspended.billingDescription: A sanction never touches your money: your invoices stay readable and your subscription cancellable at any time.
suspended.billingError: Could not open the billing portal. Try again in a moment.
suspended.emptyDescription: The sanction details could not be loaded. Contact support with your account ID.
